selection_logic.why_ready: The plan identifies exactly four new non-NOAA source groups across four declared domains, with two high-confidence institutional/public-domain USGS routes and two explicitly held NASA/Commons routes plus named fallbacks. It freezes 12 slots with balanced intervention/hop/temporal targets and fail-closed preflights. Ready means ready for metadata/rights and bounded stream preflight, not ready to download, annotate, or claim H1/H2.
selection_logic.go_to_acquisition_requirement: At least four new source groups across at least two non-NOAA domains must separately pass exact route, duration, synchronized A/V, modality-semantic, source-disjointness, rights, privacy, and custody gates. Any held NASA/Commons group may be replaced by an approved institutional fallback while preserving the slot matrix.
